name: packed_bed_nusselt
title: Packed-bed forced convection: Nusselt-number correlations (function library)
summary: Four EES FUNCTIONs returning the particle Nusselt number of forced convection in a packed bed: Nu_packed_bed_Gnielinski (single-sphere form scaled by the packing shape factor fa, sphere default selected with fa <= 0), Nu_Wakao_Kagei, Nu_Achenbach (Pr accepted but unused, as in ht) and Nu_KTA. The heat-transfer coefficient follows from h = Nu*k/dp and is left to the caller.

authors: N. Wakao and S. Kagei (Wakao-Kagei correlation)
origin.notes: ht 1.2.0, commit 85e0ee6 (2025-12-07), file ht/conv_packed_bed.py, MIT license, Copyright (C) 2016 Caleb Bell. The scientific basis of each correlation is the original paper or book cited in its function comment block (Gnielinski 1981/1982 and VDI Heat Atlas 2010; Wakao & Kagei 1982; Achenbach 1995; KTA 3102.2, 1983 - the last three as cited in Abdulmohsin & Al-Dahhan 2015). Translation published under the CoolSolve_Library MIT license (decision D3).

verification.reference: doctest values of ht 1.2.0 ht/conv_packed_bed.py (case A, including the fa=2 regression value of tests/test_conv_packed_bed.py) and additional values computed with the same ht functions in a throw-away virtualenv (case B); 10 output values in total
verification.notes: compare_solution.py: 10 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); largest relative deviation 1.4e-12 (Nu_Achenbach_B), i.e. round-off only.
